mentions.heading: Operations carried out by joint ventures with partners who may have different goals
mentions.detail: China and Korea operations, US/Canada battery and raw material JVs; primary China JV agreement expires 2027, renegotiation ongoing
mentions.quote: Our primary joint venture agreement for our China JVs expires in 2027, and we are in negotiations with our partner for a new agreement.

mentions.heading: Limited control over joint ventures and compliance
mentions.detail: Minority stakes limit control; JV misconduct, internal control issues could bring penalties, fines, reputational harm
mentions.quote: As a result, we may be unable to prevent violations of applicable laws or other misconduct by a joint venture, adverse human rights or other impacts, or the failure to satisfy contractual obligations by one or more parties.

mentions.heading: The international scale and footprint of our operations expose us to additional risks
mentions.detail: US-China tensions, dividend repatriation and technology export restrictions; FCPA exposure
mentions.quote: (5) political and economic tensions between governments and changes in international economic policies, including restrictions on the repatriation of dividends or in the export of technology, especially between China and the U.S.;

mentions.heading: Tariffs and trade barriers on global operations
mentions.detail: New or higher tariffs on products imported into or exported from the U.S.; free trade agreement changes
mentions.quote: (6) changes to customs requirements or procedures (e.g., inspections) or new or higher tariffs, for example, on products imported into or exported from the U.S., including under U.S. or other trade laws or measures, or other key markets;
